name: Vending Machine
description: Device used to sell items to players

option.label: Purchase Action
option.description: When a player purchases from the vending machine, does the device grant an item or transmit on a channel?

option.label: Required Item
option.description: The item required for a player to purchase from the vending machine

option.label: Required Item Amount
option.description: How much of the required item a player must have to purchase from the vending machine

option.label: Granted Item
option.description: When a player purchases from the vending machine, what item is granted to them?

option.label: Granted Item Amount
option.description: How much of the granted item is given to the player

option.label: When item purchased, transmit on
option.description: When a player purchases the item from the vending machine, the device sends a signal on the selected channel

option.label: Visible In-Game
option.description: Is the body of the Vending Machine present in-game?

option.label: Item Image
option.description: Supply an image shown for the item in the vending machine. Custom images are not allowed. Refer to the Gimkit Creative documentation for usage of icon images.

option.label: Item Name
option.description: The name of the item being purchased from the vending machine. By default, the name of the Granted Item is used.

option.label: Item Description
option.description: An optional description of the item being purchased from the vending machine.

option.label: Deactivate On Purchase
option.description: If enabled, the vending machine will deactivate after the item is purchased.

option.label: Use Adaptive Cost
option.description: If enabled, the cost of the item will increase based on the number of players in-game

option.label: Adaptive Cost Increase Per Player
option.description: How much the cost of the item increases per additional player

option.label: Allow Funding
option.description: If enabled, players can fund the vending machine to decrease the cost of the item

option.label: Funding Scope
option.description: For funding, the current price of the item is applied to who?

option.label: Use Limited Stock
option.description: If enabled, the vending machine will be out of stock after a certain amount of purchases

option.label: Limited Stock Amount
option.description: The maximum amount of purchases that can be made from the vending machine before it goes out of stock

option.label: Limited Stock Scope
option.description: The current stock of the vending machine is applied to who?

option.label: Attach Cost To Name
option.description: When enabled, the cost of the item will be added to the end of the item's name

option.label: Active On Game Start
option.description: Is this vending machine available to make purchases from when the game starts?

option.label: Active Scope
option.description: When activated/deactivated, who does it apply to?

option.label: Activate when receiving on
option.description: Activate the vending machine when the device receives a signal from the selected channel

option.label: Deactivate when receiving on
option.description: Deactivate the vending machine when the device receives a signal from the selected channel

option.label: Team Allowed To Purchased
option.description: Which team is allowed to purchase from the vending machine?

option.label: Attempt to purchase when receiving on
option.description: Attempt to purchase an item from the vending machine when the device receives a signal from the selected channel

option.label: When attempted purchase failed, transmit on
option.description: When a player attempted to purchase an item from the vending machine, but failed, the device sends a signal on the selected channel

option.label: Interaction Duration
option.description: How long does a player have to interact with the vending machine to make the purchase?

option.label: Match Item Rarity
option.description: Match the colors of the vending machine to the granted item's rarity

option.label: Exterior Color
option.description: The color of the vending machine background exterior

option.label: Interior Color
option.description: The color of the vending machine background interior

option.label: Rays Color
option.description: The color of the rays rotating on the vending machine

option.label: Sound Enabled
option.description: Play a sound effect when the item is purchased

option.label: Cast Shadow
option.description: Does the vending machine cast a shadow?
